3.happening: We record n = {n}, the string length.
3.why: Both loops are bounded by n.

4.why: No run has been measured yet.
4.invariant: best is the longest unique run found so far.

5.why: It marks where the best run begins, for highlighting.
5.invariant: best_start points at the start of the best run.

6.happening: We set the first start index i = 0.
6.why: Every start position gets its own run.
6.invariant: i marks the run's left edge.

7.happening: We try a run starting at index {i}.
7.why: The longest unique substring must start somewhere.
7.invariant: Starts before i have already been measured.

7.happening: Every start has been tried, so scanning stops.
7.why: There are no more starting positions.
7.invariant: best holds the overall longest run.

8.happening: We reset seen to empty for this run.
8.why: Each run tracks its own set of characters.
8.invariant: seen holds exactly the run's current characters.

9.happening: We reset this run's length to 0.
9.why: The run is measured from scratch at each start.
9.invariant: length counts characters in the current run.

10.happening: We put the run's right edge j at the start {i}.
10.why: The run grows rightward from its start.

11.happening: We try to extend the run to include index {j}.
11.why: A longer run may still be unique.

11.happening: The run reached the end of the string.
11.why: There is nothing more to add.
11.invariant: The run i..j-1 is maximal for this start.

12.happening: We read the candidate character s[{j}].
12.why: We must check it does not already appear in the run.
12.invariant: ch is the character at the run's right edge.

13.happening: We test whether s[{j}] is already inside the run.
13.why: A repeated character is what ends a unique run.
13.invariant: is_dup is True exactly when the character repeats.

14.happening: s[{j}] already appears in the run, so it must stop.
14.why: A repeat breaks the 'all distinct' rule.
14.invariant: The run keeps only distinct characters.

14.happening: s[{j}] is new to the run, so the run can grow.

15.happening: We stop extending this run at the repeat.
15.why: Nothing past a repeat can be part of this unique run.

16.happening: We add the new character to seen.
16.why: It is now part of the current unique run.

17.why: One more distinct character was added.
17.invariant: length equals j - i after this step.

18.happening: We advance the run's right edge.
18.invariant: j only moves rightward within a run.

19.happening: This run's length {length} beats the best {best}.
19.why: We keep the longest run seen.
19.invariant: best tracks the maximum run length.

19.happening: This run's length {length} does not beat best {best}.

20.why: A longer unique run was found.
20.invariant: best is the longest run so far.

21.why: So the best run can stay highlighted.
21.invariant: best_start marks the winning run's start.

22.happening: We move to the next start index.
22.invariant: Starts are tried left to right.

23.why: Every start's run has been measured.
23.invariant: best is the length of the longest unique substring.

init.happening: Set up the best length and the first start.

loop.happening: Try a new start or extend the current run.
loop.why: Every start and extension is examined.
loop.invariant: The current run is always all-distinct.

update.happening: Grow the run or record a new best.
update.why: Each run is measured and compared.

move.happening: Advance the run edge or the start.

check.happening: Test a repeat or a new best.
check.why: These bound the run and update the answer.
